author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮೂಲಗುರಿಯೊಂದಿಹುದು ತಲುಪೆ ದಾರಿಯು ನೂರು
ಜಾಲಗಳು ನೂರಿಹವು ಗುರಿ ವಿಫಲಗೊಳಿಸೆ
ಕಾಲಜೊತೆಗಿರಲಾಗಿ ಸಾಧಿಸುವ ಛಲವಿರಲು
ಸೋಲು ನಿನ ಬಳಿಬರದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There is one root goal and a hundred ways to reach it;
there are a hundred nets to make the goal fail;
if, with time on your side, you have the grit to achieve,
defeat will not come near you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Every goal has many paths and many traps. With patience and determination, defeat cannot touch us.
